revision_reason: The initial direct A2 cell was rejected before a source total. Revision 2 distributes only its unchanged M_H OR M_B factor into two cells.
objective: Replace the prospective Atom route with a rendered Advanced Search translation for all nine direct partitions and validate complete capture.

date_window.status: labelled pilot window, not the unset common review cutoff

controls.publication_type: arXiv submissions/e-prints, with no type limiter
controls.screenshots: mandatory automatic configured-search PNG before execution and first-results PNG for every source event

translation.ordinary_block: all literals joined by homogeneous uppercase OR inside one rendered All-fields row
translation.conjunction: one rendered row per factor, joined by outer AND controls

compound_distribution.A2: two-cell union: P AND E_F AND M_H, then P AND E_F AND M_B
compound_distribution.BG1: two-cell union: P AND (G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact), then P AND G_mission AND M_B
compound_distribution.BG2: two-cell union: P AND (G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation), then P AND G_product AND M_B
